resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Texas Escapes narrative says a post office was granted in the 1890s, while the marker text it quotes says Surveyville Post Office opened in 1903. The story follows the marker text.

notes_for_editor: Only tower record is the Forest Fire Lookout Association one-line listing (standing, Newton County, coordinates). No build date, height, design, staffing, fires or access found in the sources read. The Texas Escapes narrative also gives the 1834 land grant as 1934; its quoted marker says 1834, and the story does not use the grant year. Lead: the Cavallerano book Fire in the Piney Woods (muse.jhu.edu/book/137054) is described as covering every Texas fire lookout tower; not accessed, and it may hold the build record. Worth asking the Texas Forest Service or Texas Historical Commission. Used 2 WebSearch calls; page reads: FFLA list, HMDB marker, NHLR list, FFLA p=784 (table not in text), Wikipedia, Texas Escapes. Verification 2026-10-09: story now says 'unincorporated community' (Wikipedia wording) instead of 'small community', and drops 'named for the community', which no source gives.
